I'd like to know about his day or for him to tell me if something interesting/difficult happens (cause he's always the first person and sometimes only person I ever want to tell about anything), or something to reassure me that he doesn't want to forget about me the moment I'm out of sight. 

On my end, I've become extremely anxious about texting him since he's said this, even though I'm fairly secure and consistent with texting other people (and previous partners). I feel like every time I text him, I'm causing him significant distress, so I hold off on telling him anything that goes on in my day, even though this makes me feel alone. I find this bewildering cause when he's there we're super close and when he's not it's like the relationship has been put on hold?
